Folders come first because they are what Import did before it knew any convention; the vendor conventions follow in Mask's vendor order, each labelled with its vendor and marked when spaCR is guessing about it.

records.source: The same list Mask's ``metadata_type`` offers, read from :func:`spacr.regex_infer._metadata_convention_menu`, so a plate Mask can parse is a plate Import can parse and the two lists cannot drift. Folders come first because they are what Import did before it knew any convention; the vendor conventions follow in Mask's vendor order, each labelled with its vendor and marked when spaCR is guessing about it.
records.translation: La même liste que celle proposée par ``metadata_type`` de Mask, lue depuis :func:`spacr.regex_infer._metadata_convention_menu`, de sorte qu’une plaque que Mask sait analyser est une plaque qu’Import sait analyser et que les deux listes ne peuvent pas diverger. Les dossiers viennent en premier, car c’est ce que faisait Import avant de connaître la moindre convention ; les conventions des fabricants suivent dans l’ordre des fabricants de Mask, chacune étiquetée avec son fabricant et signalée lorsque spaCR fait une supposition à son sujet.

records.context: One helper serves every screen. The cached-or-download decision, the button's busy state and the failure message are the same for Plate Viewer, Tabulate, Graph Builder and the rest; what differs is only which field is filled and which method opens it. So a screen passes that one difference as a callback and nothing else.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.measurements_example#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: One helper serves every screen. The cached-or-download decision, the button's busy state and the failure message are the same for Plate Viewer, Tabulate, Graph Builder and the rest; what differs is only which field is filled and which method opens it. So a screen passes that one difference as a callback and nothing else.
records.translation: Une seule fonction utilitaire sert tous les écrans. Le choix entre cache et téléchargement, l’état occupé du bouton et le message d’échec sont identiques pour Plate Viewer, Tabulate, Graph Builder et les autres ; seuls changent le champ rempli et la méthode qui l’ouvre. Un écran transmet donc cette seule différence sous forme de fonction de rappel, et rien d’autre.

records.context: The download reuses existing code. The archive, the worker and the progress dialog are :func:`spacr.qt.hf_download.download_annotate_example`, the same call Classify's button makes, and a plate already unpacked by any of them is reused without touching the network.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.measurements_example#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The download reuses existing code. The archive, the worker and the progress dialog are :func:`spacr.qt.hf_download.download_annotate_example`, the same call Classify's button makes, and a plate already unpacked by any of them is reused without touching the network.
records.translation: Le téléchargement réutilise du code existant. L’archive, le worker et la boîte de dialogue de progression sont ceux de :func:`spacr.qt.hf_download.download_annotate_example`, le même appel que celui du bouton de Classify, et une plaque déjà décompressée par l’un d’eux est réutilisée sans accès au réseau.

records.context: Read from package data on every call; the folder holds a handful of small files and is only read when Experiment Design builds its menu. A file that does not parse is skipped rather than raised, so one bad template does not remove the others from the menu.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Read from package data on every call; the folder holds a handful of small files and is only read when Experiment Design builds its menu. A file that does not parse is skipped rather than raised, so one bad template does not remove the others from the menu.
records.translation: Lu depuis les données du paquet à chaque appel ; le dossier ne contient que quelques petits fichiers et n’est lu que lorsque Experiment Design construit son menu. Un fichier qui ne s’analyse pas est ignoré au lieu de lever une exception, de sorte qu’un modèle défectueux ne retire pas les autres du menu.
